units.rawText: Eucharist scrutinizes the black pawn in her hand, speaking as if to herself.
units.displayText: Eucharist scrutinizes the black pawn in her hand, speaking as if to herself.

spans.text: Eucharist scrutinizes the black pawn in her hand, speaking as if to herself.

units.rawText: You know, Professor, when we play these games, we tend to think of ourselves as the players or, at the very least, the king.
units.displayText: You know, Professor, when we play these games, we tend to think of ourselves as the players or, at the very least, the king.

spans.text: You know, Professor, when we play these games, we tend to think of ourselves as the players or, at the very least, the king.

units.rawText: Have you ever thought... that perhaps you yourself are a pawn?
units.displayText: Have you ever thought... that perhaps you yourself are a pawn?

spans.text: Have you ever thought... that perhaps you yourself are a pawn?

units.rawText: Eucharist looks into my eyes, pushing her pawn forward.
units.displayText: Eucharist looks into my eyes, pushing her pawn forward.

spans.text: Eucharist looks into my eyes, pushing her pawn forward.

units.rawText: Guided along back and forth by a true player, life tossed away in some grand contest you have no stake in...
units.displayText: Guided along back and forth by a true player, life tossed away in some grand contest you have no stake in...

spans.text: Guided along back and forth by a true player, life tossed away in some grand contest you have no stake in...

units.rawText: Or perhaps your sacrifice is utterly meaningless in the grand scheme of things. Is that not pitiful?
units.displayText: Or perhaps your sacrifice is utterly meaningless in the grand scheme of things. Is that not pitiful?

spans.text: Or perhaps your sacrifice is utterly meaningless in the grand scheme of things. Is that not pitiful?

units.rawText: Is that what you think?
units.displayText: Is that what you think?

spans.text: Is that what you think?

units.rawText: You can think of it as this black pawn's thoughts, or this black king's thoughts... or whoever you desire.
units.displayText: You can think of it as this black pawn's thoughts, or this black king's thoughts... or whoever you desire.

spans.text: You can think of it as this black pawn's thoughts, or this black king's thoughts... or whoever you desire.

units.rawText: Then, let's say I am talking to the source of those ideas.
units.displayText: Then, let's say I am talking to the source of those ideas.

spans.text: Then, let's say I am talking to the source of those ideas.

units.rawText: I place my hand on the white queen.
units.displayText: I place my hand on the white queen.

spans.text: I place my hand on the white queen.

units.rawText: I am diametrically opposed to you. To me, people and pieces are quite distinct.
units.displayText: I am diametrically opposed to you. To me, people and pieces are quite distinct.

spans.text: I am diametrically opposed to you. To me, people and pieces are quite distinct.

units.rawText: What you take for "pieces" does not stay on the board as you desire. They may slip out of your jurisdiction at any moment and act outside of the board. Even the most obedient tool of yours has a chance to abandon the rules you lay out.
units.displayText: What you take for "pieces" does not stay on the board as you desire. They may slip out of your jurisdiction at any moment and act outside of the board. Even the most obedient tool of yours has a chance to abandon the rules you lay out.

spans.text: What you take for "pieces" does not stay on the board as you desire. They may slip out of your jurisdiction at any moment and act outside of the board. Even the most obedient tool of yours has a chance to abandon the rules you lay out.

units.rawText: Those who purport to control others often find themselves in the pitfalls of their own making.
units.displayText: Those who purport to control others often find themselves in the pitfalls of their own making.

spans.text: Those who purport to control others often find themselves in the pitfalls of their own making.

units.rawText: That's because you're a human, Professor. Would you say the same for machines?
units.displayText: That's because you're a human, Professor. Would you say the same for machines?

spans.text: That's because you're a human, Professor. Would you say the same for machines?

units.rawText: I look at Eucharist, surprised. She smiles at me, her chin still resting on her hands, seeing nothing wrong with her previous statement.
units.displayText: I look at Eucharist, surprised. She smiles at me, her chin still resting on her hands, seeing nothing wrong with her previous statement.

spans.text: I look at Eucharist, surprised. She smiles at me, her chin still resting on her hands, seeing nothing wrong with her previous statement.

units.rawText: ...Yes, I would.
units.displayText: ...Yes, I would.

spans.text: ...Yes, I would.

units.rawText: After some deliberation, I remove my hand from the white queen, turning my attention towards a bishop instead.
units.displayText: After some deliberation, I remove my hand from the white queen, turning my attention towards a bishop instead.

spans.text: After some deliberation, I remove my hand from the white queen, turning my attention towards a bishop instead.

units.rawText: I believe that every agent has their own free will.
units.displayText: I believe that every agent has their own free will.

spans.text: I believe that every agent has their own free will.

units.rawText: "Free will" again...
units.displayText: "Free will" again...

spans.text: "Free will" again...

units.rawText: Eucharist sighs, suddenly noticing that white's move was already made.
units.displayText: Eucharist sighs, suddenly noticing that white's move was already made.

spans.text: Eucharist sighs, suddenly noticing that white's move was already made.

units.rawText: Well, well, looks like a fine position you've put yourself in.
units.displayText: Well, well, looks like a fine position you've put yourself in.

spans.text: Well, well, looks like a fine position you've put yourself in.

units.rawText: Making such good moves while distracting me with talk—how despicable, Professor.
units.displayText: Making such good moves while distracting me with talk—how despicable, Professor.

spans.text: Making such good moves while distracting me with talk—how despicable, Professor.

units.rawText: "Always looking outside the game will lead you to blunder, you know." Your words.
units.displayText: "Always looking outside the game will lead you to blunder, you know." Your words.

spans.text: "Always looking outside the game will lead you to blunder, you know." Your words.

units.rawText: You're always so proficient at latching onto what people say, Professor. I'll have to watch my words, it seems.
units.displayText: You're always so proficient at latching onto what people say, Professor. I'll have to watch my words, it seems.

spans.text: You're always so proficient at latching onto what people say, Professor. I'll have to watch my words, it seems.

units.rawText: However, since the answer is already in your hands, I think it's about time for this game to end.
units.displayText: However, since the answer is already in your hands, I think it's about time for this game to end.

spans.text: However, since the answer is already in your hands, I think it's about time for this game to end.

units.rawText: Eucharist moves the black queen.
units.displayText: Eucharist moves the black queen.

spans.text: Eucharist moves the black queen.

units.rawText: It seems that we are in agreement.
units.displayText: It seems that we are in agreement.

spans.text: It seems that we are in agreement.

units.rawText: The moment the white side's time begins to tick down again, I nudge the white queen forward two squares.
units.displayText: The moment the white side's time begins to tick down again, I nudge the white queen forward two squares.

spans.text: The moment the white side's time begins to tick down again, I nudge the white queen forward two squares.

units.rawText: What?!
units.displayText: What?!

spans.text: What?!

units.rawText: Eucharist stands up in shock. The nearby jellyfish Entropics seem thoroughly oblivious, continuing in their dance.
units.displayText: Eucharist stands up in shock. The nearby jellyfish Entropics seem thoroughly oblivious, continuing in their dance.

spans.text: Eucharist stands up in shock. The nearby jellyfish Entropics seem thoroughly oblivious, continuing in their dance.

units.rawText: What, have I exceeded your expectations?
units.displayText: What, have I exceeded your expectations?

spans.text: What, have I exceeded your expectations?

units.rawText: Ha... How ruthless of you, Professor. You would sacrifice your queen?
units.displayText: Ha... How ruthless of you, Professor. You would sacrifice your queen?

spans.text: Ha... How ruthless of you, Professor. You would sacrifice your queen?

units.rawText: One must be willing to wager when an opportunity arises. And as you can see...
units.displayText: One must be willing to wager when an opportunity arises. And as you can see...

spans.text: One must be willing to wager when an opportunity arises. And as you can see...

units.rawText: After a few further exchanges, I hover my hand over a white pawn.
units.displayText: After a few further exchanges, I hover my hand over a white pawn.

spans.text: After a few further exchanges, I hover my hand over a white pawn.

units.rawText: The real queen is here, is it not?
units.displayText: The real queen is here, is it not?

spans.text: The real queen is here, is it not?

units.rawText: Eucharist watches dumbstruck as I pick up my pawn, her queen and king still confined to a singular row, unable to act.
units.displayText: Eucharist watches dumbstruck as I pick up my pawn, her queen and king still confined to a singular row, unable to act.

spans.text: Eucharist watches dumbstruck as I pick up my pawn, her queen and king still confined to a singular row, unable to act.

units.rawText: <color=orange>White pawn forward, promoting to queen.</color>
units.displayText: White pawn forward, promoting to queen.

spans.text: White pawn forward, promoting to queen.

units.rawText: As the pawn lands on the final rank, its form swiftly transforms as if undergoing eclosion, taking on the shape of a queen.
units.displayText: As the pawn lands on the final rank, its form swiftly transforms as if undergoing eclosion, taking on the shape of a queen.

spans.text: As the pawn lands on the final rank, its form swiftly transforms as if undergoing eclosion, taking on the shape of a queen.

units.rawText: Like I said before, those "pieces" will, at one time or another, exceed the player's expectations.
units.displayText: Like I said before, those "pieces" will, at one time or another, exceed the player's expectations.

spans.text: Like I said before, those "pieces" will, at one time or another, exceed the player's expectations.
